```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_2_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_2")
figure_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "figures")

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))

```

```{r}
#analytic sample
dem_solo_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    !participant.code %in% c("l6gxo7po", "n0ndmyka")
  ) # Two participants excluded due to technical errors

solo_ids <- dem_solo_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

solo_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO") %>%
  semi_join(solo_ids, by = "id")
```

```{r}
# Derive duration and sound-condition variables
solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    any_sound = as.integer(replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE)),
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm"),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "alarm_only",
        "cry_only",
        "mixed_cry_alarm"))) %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm") %>%
  droplevels()
```

#############
Duration model fit on just answered rounds
```{r}
duration_data <- solo_rounds %>%
  filter(
    completed == 1,
    round_sound_type %in% c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only"),
    !is.na(log_secs),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(participant.code)) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = relevel(gender, ref = "Female"),
    round_sound_type = relevel(
      round_sound_type,
      ref = "none"))

duration_dist_df <- duration_data %>%
  dplyr::select(secs, log_secs) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(secs, log_secs),
    names_to = "scale",
    values_to = "duration") %>%
  mutate(
    scale = factor(
      scale,
      levels = c("secs", "log_secs"),
      labels = c(
        "Raw round duration",
        "Log-transformed round duration")))

p_duration_transform <- ggplot(
  duration_dist_df,
  aes(x = duration)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "grey35",
    colour = "grey35") +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ scale,
    scales = "free_x",
    ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 25, 20, 25)  )

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s2_duration_raw_log_distributions.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_duration_transform,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
duration_model <- lmer(
  log_secs ~ round_sound_type * gender +
    (1 | participant.code),
  data = duration_data,
  REML = TRUE)

summary(duration_model)

duration_summary <- coef(summary(duration_model))

cbind(
  Estimate = duration_summary[, "Estimate"],
  lower_95_CI =
    duration_summary[, "Estimate"] -
    qt(0.975, duration_summary[, "df"]) *
    duration_summary[, "Std. Error"],
  upper_95_CI =
    duration_summary[, "Estimate"] +
    qt(0.975, duration_summary[, "df"]) *
    duration_summary[, "Std. Error"])
```


```{r}
duration_emmeans <- emmeans(
  duration_model,
  ~ round_sound_type | gender,
  lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

sound_contrasts <- list(
  "alarm_only - none"     = c(-1,  1,  0),
  "cry_only - none"       = c(-1,  0,  1),
  "alarm_only - cry_only" = c( 0,  1, -1))

duration_sound_contrasts <- contrast(
  duration_emmeans,
  method = sound_contrasts)

summary(
  duration_sound_contrasts,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "holm")

duration_gender_interactions <- contrast(
  duration_sound_contrasts,
  method = "pairwise",
  by = "contrast")

summary(
  duration_gender_interactions,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "holm",
  by = NULL)

# Overall sound effect, averaged across gender
duration_emmeans_overall <- emmeans(
  duration_model,
  ~ round_sound_type,
  weights = "equal",
  lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

overall_sound_contrast <- contrast(
  duration_emmeans_overall,
  method = list(
    "sound - no sound" = c(-1, 0.5, 0.5)))

summary(
  overall_sound_contrast,
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
```

#####################
Duration model diagnostics

```{r}
## Analytic sample and cell sizes
duration_data %>%
  count(gender, round_sound_type) %>%
  arrange(gender, round_sound_type)

duration_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant.code),
    min_secs = min(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_secs = max(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zero_secs = sum(secs == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative_secs = sum(secs < 0, na.rm = TRUE))

## Number of observations contributed by each participant
duration_data %>%
  count(participant.code, gender, name = "n_rounds") %>%
  summarise(
    min_rounds = min(n_rounds),
    median_rounds = median(n_rounds),
    mean_rounds = mean(n_rounds),
    max_rounds = max(n_rounds))

## Model checks
isSingular(duration_model, tol = 1e-4)

VarCorr(duration_model)

duration_model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages

fixed_effect_matrix <- getME(duration_model, "X")

c(number_of_columns = ncol(fixed_effect_matrix),
  matrix_rank = qr(fixed_effect_matrix)$rank)
```

```{r}
## Residual diagnostics

duration_diagnostics <- tibble(
  fitted = fitted(duration_model),
  residual = resid(duration_model),
  standardised_residual =
    resid(duration_model) / sigma(duration_model))

# Panel A: residuals versus fitted values
p_duration_residuals_fitted <-
  ggplot(
    duration_diagnostics,
    aes(
      x = fitted,
      y = standardised_residual)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.3) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(-2, 2),
    linetype = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    x = "Fitted log duration",
    y = "Standardised residual") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel B: normal Q-Q plot
p_duration_residual_qq <-
  ggplot(
    duration_diagnostics,
    aes(sample = standardised_residual)) +
  stat_qq(
    alpha = 0.50,
    size = 1.3) +
  stat_qq_line(
    linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "B.",
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Observed quantiles") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel C: histogram of standardised residuals
p_duration_residual_histogram <-
  ggplot(
    duration_diagnostics,
    aes(x = standardised_residual)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    boundary = 0) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "C.",
    x = "Standardised residual",
    y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Combined diagnostic figure
p_study2_duration_diagnostics <-
  p_duration_residuals_fitted /
  ( p_duration_residual_qq +
      p_duration_residual_histogram) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1, 1))

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s2_duration_model_diagnostics.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_study2_duration_diagnostics,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300)
```


###################
Figure

```{r}
# Participant-level mean log-transformed duration within each condition
duration_participant_log_means <- duration_data %>%
  group_by(
    participant.code,
    gender,
    round_sound_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log_secs = mean(log_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only"),
      labels = c("No sound", "Alarm", "Infant cry")))

# Model-estimated means on the model scale
duration_emmeans_plot <- 
  summary(
    duration_emmeans,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only"),
      labels = c("No sound", "Alarm", "Infant cry")))

# Pairwise sound contrasts by gender
duration_effects_plot_data <- 
  summary(
    duration_sound_contrasts,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    adjust = "holm") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    contrast = recode(
      contrast,
      "alarm_only - none" = "Alarm versus no sound",
      "cry_only - none" = "Infant cry versus no sound",
      "alarm_only - cry_only" = "Alarm versus infant cry"),
    contrast = factor(
      contrast,
      levels = c(
        "Alarm versus infant cry",
        "Infant cry versus no sound",
        "Alarm versus no sound")),
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")))

# Female–male differences in the sound contrasts
duration_interaction_plot_data <- 
  summary(
    duration_gender_interactions,
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    adjust = "holm",
    by = NULL) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    sound_comparison = recode(
      as.character(contrast),
      "alarm_only - none" = "Alarm versus no sound",
      "cry_only - none" = "Infant cry versus no sound",
      "alarm_only - cry_only" = "Alarm versus infant cry"),
    sound_comparison = factor(
      sound_comparison,
      levels = c(
        "Alarm versus infant cry",
        "Infant cry versus no sound",
        "Alarm versus no sound")))

gender_colours <- c(
  "Female" = "#2A9D8F",
  "Male" = "#eb8005")

duration_dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.78)

# Panel A
p_duration_distribution <- 
  ggplot(
    duration_participant_log_means,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      y = mean_log_secs,
      fill = gender,
      colour = gender)) +
  geom_violin(
    aes(group = interaction(round_sound_type, gender)),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = 0.70,
    scale = "width",
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.07,
      jitter.height = 0,
      dodge.width = 0.78),
    size = 1.7,
    alpha = 0.40) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = duration_emmeans_plot,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      ymin = lower.CL,
      ymax = upper.CL,
      colour = gender),
    position = duration_dodge,
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = duration_emmeans_plot,
    aes(
      x = round_sound_type,
      y = emmean,
      colour = gender),
    position = duration_dodge,
    size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gender_colours) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gender_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "A.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log-transformed answered-round duration",
    fill = NULL,
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel B
p_duration_effects_final <- 
  ggplot(
    duration_effects_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = estimate,
      y = contrast,
      colour = gender)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower.CL,
      xmax = upper.CL),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45),
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45),
    size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gender_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "B.",
    x = "Estimated difference in log-transformed round duration",
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel C
p_duration_interactions <- 
  ggplot(
    duration_interaction_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = estimate,
      y = sound_comparison)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lower.CL,
      xmax = upper.CL),
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(
    size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "C.",
    x = "Female–male difference in the sound contrast",
    y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Combined figure
p_duration_full <-
  p_duration_distribution +
  (p_duration_effects_final / p_duration_interactions) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1.25, 1),
    guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "top")

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s2_duration_full_figure.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_duration_full,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300)

```
